The parent may append review/accounting evidence after that identity; this review binds the frozen trees. Cwd and Git roots were verified in both worktrees before Git inspection. Repositories remained read-only; the sole write was this assigned scratch report.

Producer/consumer coverage and disposition:
1. The twenty new libs/shared/catalog/src/studies/aifg/*.json records were traced through aifg.ts imports/exports, studies-summary.json, catalog-loader.ts studyChunks/summary/study, study-models.ts and study-models.spec.ts, and the inventory/e2e consumers. All twenty visual.model paths equal their TypeScript executable.module paths and have companion specs. Each record's example parameter key set equals its model's numberParameter reads, and each mechanism step count matches the ordinary pseudocode block count. The unchanged check-studies.mjs and concept-study model contract continue to own shape, nearby references, checked state, reviewer count, companion-spec existence and source/chunk/summary consistency. No schema or generated-data format changed.
2. tools/studies.test.mjs retains first-batch membership and pins the combined forty ids rather than replacing the original membership requirement. apps/dotln-e2e/src/catalog.spec.ts now reads the checked-in generated summary as a node file fixture typed with StudiesSummary. Its per-work and total expectations correctly move AI for Games 20 to 40 and total 60 to 80 while RxJS/EIP remain 20. The changed Seek handoff is Flee (aifg-a:111), consistent with the newly integrated numeric source order. Searches for stale literal studied counts in app/libs/tools/docs found no remaining relevant old count consumer; scene's twenty bodies are unrelated pins.
3. motion-labels.ts produces independent labelX/labelY; motion-drawing.ts carries them on bodies and marks; motion.html consumes those coordinates and draws guides back to unchanged x/y anchors. Fifteen pre-existing movement specs migrate horizontal label bounds, name separation and vector-separation calculations to labelX, preserving their physical-position assertions and prior thresholds. The drawing's focused specs, study-models.spec.ts full-default-corpus retention check and movement-labels.spec.ts actual-glyph checks consume the same contract. The unchanged velocity-matching physical x-gap assertion still checks body separation; the new corpus oracle independently covers its labels. Other unchanged labelY-only consumers remain valid. No fixture or copy/export inventory needs an entry for the internal motion-labels helper: it is reached through the normal motion-drawing import; searches found no copied drawing fixture boundary.
4. StudyView.executableModel is produced only for TypeScript executable records in study-mapper.ts and consumed by study-explanation.html. The base fixture supplies null and the marbles/flow fixture variants inherit it. Mapper and disclosure specs cover executable and illustrative branches, and the browser journey opens the actual collision-avoidance companion-spec disclosure. The tools sections of application en.json and tools/testing/tools-en.json are semantically identical. The selected chart legend comes from timeline.series, including repeated tones, while the template tracks entries by index; the existing movement/flow/marbles discriminator remains intact. Mapper, composite and browser tests cover switching the key/guide back to movement.
5. The revised wall record's goalY=15, rayLength=9, comparisonGoalY=0 and prose match the model's selected/default/comparison producers and twelve companion cases. wallClearance consistently feeds the frame values, worked arithmetic, main chart and comparison using the finite segment including endpoints. The comparison changes only goalY. The no-hit and no-turn bookmark branches correspond to the selected run and their regression; the fixed guide is qualified as the default example. The record/module/spec identity chain matches the factual and reading final receipts: reviewed source hashes remain historical, checked/reviewer metadata has a declared content identity, import-order changes have a separate identity proof, and reviewer-array formatting has its own parsed-value identity. Current after-hashes match the frozen candidate manifest.
6. The twenty bylines match fan-out.md's two-slug author assignments and author-01 through author-10 retained receipts. Their host/model wording is consistent with the original provenance and does not relabel the repair actor as original author. No new third-party runtime import, package.json, package-lock.json, Node version or runtime dependency set is introduced by this order. The new modules import existing models/scene-engine APIs and local study helpers; no additional dependency or version write-back is owed.
7. catalog.md integrates forty-study coverage, executable disclosure, chart guide and independent label placement into their current sections. D003, D012 and D026-D033 record causes for changed contracts, oracle inputs and evidence transitions, and all thirty-three decision headings are in decisions-index.md. The regenerated work-order index reports repairing/fail while WS-002 reports in progress; these agree with the live repair. D031/D032 retain the original follow-up records and attach implemented resolutions, rather than silently deleting history. D033 explicitly carries D004's order-scoped budget authorization. No launchpad release or target package version change is due in this phase.
8. The only changed visual baselines are catalog-768.png and catalog-1440.png. README.md names their studied-marker/count cause and states that the regenerated 360 image is byte-identical. catalog.visual.spec.ts still consumes the same baselines and the two existing first-batch movement subjects. label-comparison.json reports zero moved names for Flocking and Two-level formation steering, supporting why their study baselines stay unchanged. Image bytes were checked for candidate identity, not newly visually judged by this worker.
9. The retained verifier glyph instrument and labels-final.json cover forty studies at five viewports, 200 study/viewport rows and 17,375 frame observations, with zero clipped/overprinted rows. repair-1/README.md correctly limits that sweep to the geometry/name identity it measured and identifies later bookmark/caption-only changes. All 39 walkthrough image names and four final supplemental image names resolve; the supplemental manifest preserves accessibility state and viewport/input claims. Historical gates.json, validation.json, VER-001 and implementation-handoff.md remain evidence for the prior candidate. handoff.md is explicitly a current draft with new gates/review accounting pending, as the executor ladder requires; none of those admitted pending duties is reported as stale work.
10. Runtime/gate setup: the target registration retains NX_DAEMON=false and NX_ISOLATE_PLUGINS=false, plain five-command and review eight-command selections, and existing bounded command timeouts. Playwright still uses a fresh server, one worker, reduced motion, 60-second test timeout, and separate functional/visual selections. movement-labels.spec.ts waits for fonts and the rendered data-step before each glyph measurement. Visual baseline paths still bind platform and device scale factor. budgets.json's two-thirds gateShare is consumed dynamically by scripts/lib/host-resources.mjs with recorded lane capacity; hostShare is separately retained. This matches the documented observed 4 GiB/eight-lane example without hardcoding that machine value. Prior preflight failure shapes (fixture import boundary, bracket indexing, ambiguous disclosure selector, import sort and reviewer-array formatting) were checked against their changed consumers and recorded repairs.

Boundaries: no agents, background tasks, test-runner gates, suites, browser or desktop were launched. This was static source/diff, manifest and identity inspection; read-only Python scripts compared keys/counts/hashes without executing product models. Source facts, cited implementation correctness, detailed arithmetic and actual screenshot readability were not re-judged; the content critics and later independent verifier own those scopes. All candidate entries listed below were actually read for identity; listing an image or oversized historical receipt does not imply visual or line-by-line semantic review. Detailed implementation reasoning concentrated on the changed interfaces and their transitive consumers, with the wall repair and shared rendering/disclosure paths read in full. No docs/control/local or intake content was opened. Account settings, live upstream versions, network URLs and later publication surfaces were not inspected. Fresh complete target/document gates and the next independent verifier session remain later phase work.
